summary: Solves a bone chain along a guide curve and outputs rotate, bone-length, and first-bone translate channels for export-driven curve IK workflows.
key_concepts: Calculates inverse kinematics for Bone objects using a curve defined by ordered guide components.
Stretches and positions the bone chain between Bone Start and Bone End to follow the guide curve.
Outputs rotate and bone-length channels for each bone plus translate channels for the first bone in the chain.
Guide object order, pattern expansion, and orientation define the guide curve and bone X-axis alignment.
Span Start and Span End trim the fraction of the guide curve used for the solve.
Map Exports can create export links, but generated plans still need export enablement to drive the bones.

key_params.name: guide
key_params.note: Guide components that define the curve

key_params.name: span
key_params.note: Start/end fraction of the guide curve

key_params.name: span1
key_params.note: Start fraction of the guide curve

key_params.name: span2
key_params.note: End fraction of the guide curve

key_params.name: interpolation
key_params.note: Polygon, Bezier, or NURBS guide curve

key_params.name: order
key_params.note: Curve order for applicable interpolation modes

key_params.name: mapexports
key_params.note: Map calculated values to bone-chain parameters

common_gotchas: The operator needs guide objects plus a valid bone start/end chain.
It can automatically set up export links, but exports still need to be enabled deliberately.
The guide curve orientation affects how bones line up their X axes.
Use Inverse Curve SOP to inspect the generated guide/debug curves.
Span values are fractions of the guide curve, not frame or sample ranges.
